name: Interarch Building Products Ltd
tagline: High-quality, debt-free PEB manufacturer, but growth guidance has moderated sharply and a pending income-tax raid and steel-margin risk temper the story
business_overview: Interarch manufactures pre-engineered steel buildings (PEB) with ~99% in-house fabrication (no third-party outsourcing), serving industrial/commercial capex clients largely via repeat orders built on trust and execution speed. Expanding into a heavy-structure vertical (power, oil & gas) and export markets (first export order Feb 2026), with new Gujarat PEB and Andhra Pradesh heavy-structure capacity due by Jul-Aug 2026.
fundamentals_table: FY26 +31% YoY (Rs 1,898 Cr); FY28 management target implies only ~14.7% CAGR over next 2 years per community calculation
fundamentals_narrative: Genuinely high-quality balance sheet (debt-free, 23.6% ROCE) and strong trailing growth (31% YoY, 84.5% 5yr profit CAGR), but the community's own math on management's FY28 revenue target (Rs 2,500 Cr vs FY26 ~Rs 1,900 Cr) works out to only ~15% CAGR - a sharp deceleration from trailing rates. One recent post (May 2026) called the implied ~11-12% next-year growth "not exciting." Multiple posters (led by KP2018, well-received) also questioned whether 35-40x P/E is sustainable for what is fundamentally a commodity-manufacturing business exposed to steel-price swings (HRC price moved from Rs 48/kg to Rs 58/kg within months in early 2026, and PEB players are not backward-integrated into steel).
technical_read: Not independently pulled this pass - community notes the stock corrected meaningfully post-Q3FY26 concall (~10%) despite a positive US trade-deal backdrop, attributed to QIP dilution announcement and margin-compression concerns.
sentiment_summary: Read 50 of 92 available posts (of 101 total) spanning Sep 2025 to Jun 2026. Sentiment arc: a well-received contrarian caution from an industry insider (saumya2010, 31 loves, Sep 2025) kicked off sustained valuation skepticism -> strong Q2 FY26 results (Nov 2025, PAT +56% YoY) briefly offset that -> a Dec 2025 income-tax raid disclosure introduced an unresolved caution item -> from Jan-Feb 2026 the dominant topic became steel-price-driven margin compression risk (12% safeguard duty on steel imports, HRC price spike) and a QIP dilution announcement, both cited as drivers of a real stock-price correction -> by May 2026 the community's own calculation of management's FY28 target implied a growth deceleration to ~11-15% CAGR, explicitly called unexciting by one poster.
community_signal: dpk1994 (trusted) explicitly stated PEB companies "wouldn't find a place in my core portfolio" while still finding the sector worth tracking as a capex proxy - a direct, if soft, disconfirming signal from a trusted user. sougataG (trusted) offered a neutral, context-dependent view on valuation without taking a position. r8b8 (trusted) contributed an informational answer on industry differentiation (trust/repeat-order dynamics), not a conviction call. No trusted user staked an explicit buy/conviction position.
bse_notes: An income-tax raid was disclosed and flagged by the community in Dec 2025 as "something to be monitored" - no resolution or outcome has been reported in the thread as of the most recent post read. Company also announced a Rs 100 Cr QIP in early 2026.
bull_case: Debt-free balance sheet with strong ROCE (23.6%) and a genuine execution/trust moat reflected in high repeat-order share
New heavy-structure and export verticals (first export order Feb 2026) are incremental growth avenues beyond core PEB
Industry capacity expansion (Gujarat PEB, AP heavy-structure units ready by Jul-Aug 2026) sets up FY27 volume growth
Trades well below listed PEB/capex-proxy peer multiples per some community commentary despite comparable growth
bear_case: Community's own calculation of management's FY28 target implies growth decelerating to ~11-15% CAGR over the next two years - materially below the trailing 31%+ rate and weak support for a 10x-in-2-3-years thesis

Steel is >70% of cost and PEB players (including Interarch) are not backward-integrated; a documented, fast steel-price spike (Rs 48/kg to Rs 58/kg in months) is a real, unresolved margin risk on already-booked orders
Unresolved income-tax raid (disclosed Dec 2025) with no follow-up reported in the thread
A trusted user explicitly excluded PEB companies from their core portfolio; no trusted user has taken a conviction position

Stock already corrected meaningfully post-Q3FY26 concall on QIP-dilution and margin-compression concerns, suggesting the market is already pricing some of this caution in - but the underlying growth deceleration is real, not just sentiment
verdict_headline: Genuinely high-quality PEB manufacturer whose own management-guided growth trajectory has decelerated below what the thesis requires
verdict_reasoning: ROCE and balance-sheet quality clear the bar cleanly, but the community's own arithmetic on management's stated FY28 target implies ~11-15% forward growth - not consistent with a 10x-in-2-3-years case without a materially stronger catalyst than currently visible
Steel-price exposure and the unresolved income-tax raid are live, un-quantified risks rather than settled non-issues
A trusted user's explicit non-core-portfolio stance, combined with no trusted conviction call anywhere in the thread, argues against forcing a higher rating on community-signal grounds

four_box.note: Verdict explicit: community's own arithmetic on management's FY28 target 'implies ~11-15% forward growth - not consistent with a 10x-in-2-3-years case' (tailwind weak); unresolved income-tax raid and steel-price exposure are live risks; no moat/valuation detail.
